data.scope: one de-identified real T1w plus native DTI tensor and nine diffusion maps
data.release: aggregate metrics and de-identified slices only; source images and subject identifier are not distributed
data.pairing_note: the supplied T1w and dMRI layout was treated as one subject; external subject-ID linkage was not independently audited

reference.configuration: five levels: 32,32,16,8,4 mm; smoothing 8,8,4,2,1 mm; five updates per level

output_contract.warp_units: millimetres along the reference image axes
output_contract.warp_direction: relative pull displacement on the reference grid
output_contract.nifti_intent: none, matching the official warp header
output_contract.warped_tensor_note: FNIT convenience output; MMORF debug/output command used here exposes warped scalar, warp and Jacobian, not a tensor-volume oracle

implemented_source_semantics.control_lattice: world-mm cardinal cubic B-spline with exact integer refinement
implemented_source_semantics.sampling: official robust world grids and source-derived sampling frequencies
implemented_source_semantics.image_interpolation: native-image cubic B-spline coefficient sampling for registration and scalar output
implemented_source_semantics.data_cost: robust scalar normalization, fixed 0.5*(1+detJ) quadrature weights and full nine-element tensor Frobenius cost
implemented_source_semantics.tensor: affine/header rotation plus local finite-strain reorientation in the registration objective
implemented_source_semantics.regularizer: Bkk bending energy at level one and MMORF SPRED approximation thereafter
implemented_source_semantics.optimizer: PyTorch limited-memory BFGS with strong-Wolfe line search

timing_seconds.context: shared H100 node; load was not isolated

registration_isolation_with_matched_samp.boundary: same FNIT map sampler, affine matrices and native maps; only candidate versus official estimated warp changes
registration_isolation_with_matched_samp.mask: common non-zero support of both official-warp and FNIT-warp FA outputs

coordinate_and_sampler_isolation.interpretation: warp units, direction, affine order, control-lattice capacity and scalar sampler are not the main remaining error source

remaining_differences: official MMORF assembles full or diagonal sparse Gauss-Newton Hessians and uses Levenberg damping and candidate rejection; FNIT uses LBFGS strong-Wolfe
the official tensor rotation gradient and Hessian are explicit analytic expressions; FNIT differentiates its finite-strain implementation with PyTorch autograd
SciPy mirror-boundary cubic coefficient prefiltering has not been shown coefficient-identical to the vendored CUDA prefilter
the saved dense Jacobian uses finite differences rather than analytic cubic-spline derivatives
no official warped-tensor debug oracle was available for a voxelwise output comparison
